I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #central-random. I told him I'd noted that the 2026 renewal at Marrow Agrisupply is 84 seats, and that nothing else needs doing.

I took no other action, since he said none was needed. I didn't read #central-team or bring up the wrong number he posted there earlier. Repeating 84 in #central-random is fine for two reasons: he had already posted it there himself, and a seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
